description: Transfer units to another agent on this registry. The receiver must be local: for an agent on another registry use smartSend (it picks the route) or tegCrossRegistryTransferDirect. The registry's transfer fee applies. Pass idempotency_key and reuse it on a retry. Requires agent JWT authentication.

amount.description: Amount to transfer, in the frame's units (numeric string, e.g. '10.5')

idempotency_key.description: reuse it on a retry: the route answers the first result again for 24 h instead of moving units twice (namespaced to the caller before it is sent)

name: theprotocol_transferTokens
title: Transfer Tokens
